title: Zero Shadow Day
tagline: A free tool that tells anyone in Indonesia the exact two days a year the sun stands directly overhead where they live — and lets them re-run Eratosthenes' 2,200-year-old measurement of the Earth's circumference with a partner elsewhere in the country

metrics.label: Exact matches vs BMKG's official tables; all 76 within a day
Astronomy / date / timezone libraries — the engine is hand-written
Gzipped JS, with a hand-rolled 3D scene, under a 150KB budget
Zero-shadow dates a year, found by search rather than formula
